== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Macroscan (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Macroscan]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-macroscan/ swccgcards.com], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Macroscan.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>518b570cc5b9d5233e8156e110e6911fb720284d86a9bacdc33490fa09cc503b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
